project.title: Db2 Intelligence — Enterprise AI Data Copilot
project.short_description: Natural-language questions to IBM Db2 SQL, checked before anything runs by a Db2-aware SQL guard: allow-list static analysis, prepare-only cost estimation from the package cache and EXPLAIN_FROM_SECTION plan inspection with verified rollback. Generated SQL is never executed automatically.

members.name: Full Name
members.role: Backend, Db2 integration, SQL guard and AI workflow

features_used: Relational tables, primary/foreign keys, check constraints, indexes and a view
Catalog remarks (COMMENT ON) and SYSCAT catalog views
SYSPROC.EXPLAIN_FROM_SECTION with the Db2 explain tables
Native VECTOR(768, FLOAT32) columns (VECTOR_DISTANCE search planned)

ai_models: Ollama local chat model (configurable, default qwen2.5-coder:7b)
